intro_notes: NOTE: Scouts should obey all local fishing regulations and property laws. NOTE: The official merit badge pamphlets are now free and downloadable HERE or can be purchased at the Scout Shop.

requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while participating in fly-fishing activities and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. Name and explain five safety practices you should always follow while fly-fishing. (b) Discuss the prevention of and treatment for the following health concerns that could occur while fly-fishing: cuts and scratches, puncture wounds, insect bites, hypothermia, dehydration, heat exhaustion, heatstroke, and sunburn. (c) Explain how to remove a hook that has lodged in someone's arm.

requirements.lead_text: Demonstrate how to tie proper knots to prepare a fly rod for fishing:
requirements.req_text: Demonstrate how to tie proper knots to prepare a fly rod for fishing: (a) Tie backing to the arbor of a fly reel spool using an arbor knot. (b) Tie backing to the fly line using a nail (tube) knot. (c) Attach a leader to the fly line using a nail (tube) knot or a loop-to-loop connection. (d) Add a tippet to a leader using a surgeon's knot or a loop-to-loop connection. (e) Tie a fly onto the terminal end of the leader using an improved clinch knot.

common_misconception_pair.fact: Each Scout must actively explain the specific principles and real-world steps of If regulations and health concerns permit, clean and grounded in the official Fly-Fishing pamphlet.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 11): If regulations and health concerns permit, clean and cook a fish you have caught.
Core Standard 2 (Req 11): If you are unable to catch a fish for eating, acquire a fish, clean the fish you acquired, and cook the fish you acquired.
Core Standard 3 (Req 11): Note: It is not required that you eat the fish.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Record concrete observations, examples, and sketches in your Fly-Fishing Workbook before requesting Requirement 11 sign-off.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 11): Review the official Fly-Fishing requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing If regulations and health concerns permit, clean and.
Execute & Document: Perform the explain task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Fly-Fishing Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

options: Agree with the claim so the patrol can finish the requirement faster
